explanation: The pole is a clinical-medicine detector whose peak is sex and reproduction: prose about human disease, patients, procedures and anatomy (cardiology, dermatology, paediatrics, oncology, ophthalmology) raises it to roughly 1-1.6 mean strength with peaks of 2-3, while gynaecological, obstetric, urogenital or andrological subject matter (women of reproductive age, cervical, breast, ovarian, uterine, vaginal, prenatal, obstetric, contraceptive, sexual, testicular, prostate) drives it to its maximum of 3.8-5.0, firing on whichever token is current within the passage. It stays near zero on text carrying no body, disease or clinical vocabulary (economics, law, physics, sports, plant biology, code), and its output direction suppresses the explicit sex/gender vocabulary (sexual, sex, male, female, women, gender, marriage) while promoting no coherent token set, so it tracks discourse retrospectively rather than preparing one upcoming token.
